description: This file defines the DeployedRelationships class, which manages relationships between modules in the SuiteCRM system. It handles loading, saving, building, and deleting relationship metadata, as well as layout modifications related to relationships.

classes.name: DeployedRelationships
classes.description: A class managing deployed module relationships, including loading, building, saving, and deleting relationship definitions, as well as layout modifications related to relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DeployedRelationships instance for a specific module and loads its relationships.

methods.name: findRelatableModules
methods.description: Returns modules that can have relationships with the current module, including activities submodules.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads deployed relationships for the current module, incorporating metadata and external definitions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current set of relationships to a working file.

methods.name: _updateRelationshipDefinition
methods.description: Placeholder for updating relationship definitions to newer versions; currently returns input unmodified.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a specific relationship, including related layout and cache updates.

methods.name: getAllRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves all relevant relationships for the module, combining current and deployed ones.

methods.name: identifySubpanel
methods.description: Determines the subpanel name for a relationship between modules based on subpanel definitions.

methods.name: identifyRelateField
methods.description: Finds the relate field of a module that references another module.

methods.name: enforceRelationshipOnly
methods.description: Flags relationships as 'relationship_only' if they could cause UI conflicts (currently commented out).

methods.name: build
methods.description: Implements all relationships for the module, installing metadata and rebuilding relationships in the system.

methods.name: saveFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Adds relationship fields to module layouts like DetailView and EditView.

methods.name: removeFieldsFromDeployedLayout
methods.description: Removes relationship fields from module layouts after relationship deletion.
